facts.fact: OONI states that the Uganda Communications Commission ordered a shutdown of public internet access from 13 January 2026, which lasted until 18 January and included election day, with traffic dropping almost completely per IODA, Cloudflare and Google data.
OONI states that after internet access was restored on 18 January 2026, WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram and Twitter/X were blocked in Uganda, which the UCC confirmed in an announcement that day.
